input.question: What is the point of payday loans? Why can't you cash a paycheck immediately?
input.ground_truth: A payday loan is like getting paid early. When you get the loan, you haven't actually gotten paid from your job yet but you need money and you pay the loan back plus interest when you get paid from your job.

Question: What is the point of payday loans? Why can't you cash a paycheck immediately?

response.prediction:
Okay, let’s imagine you have a big cookie that your mom is going to give you at the end of the week. But right now, you really want a cookie because you’re hungry. Some stores will let you borrow a cookie now, but they say, “You have to give us a little bit more cookie next week because we let you have one early.”

That’s kind of how a payday loan works. If you need money before you get your paycheck, some people or companies will give you money now, but you have to pay them back a little more later, when you get your paycheck.

Now, about cashing a paycheck: your paycheck is like that cookie your mom promised. But she has to make sure the cookie is really yours before you can have it. She has to make sure she really owes you that cookie (that you really worked for it), and that everything is okay with the numbers. So, you have to wait until the right day to get your cookie (your paycheck), so everyone knows it’s really yours and everything is fair.
